incidents.name: IT transfer-to-pair mints to pair
incidents.notes: Transferring IT out of the IT/USDT pair also mints IT back to the pair, so the attacker used a PancakeV3 flash loan to cycle transfers and swaps and extract the USDT reserve.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x1AC5Fac863c0a026e029B173f2AE4D33938AB473 created 2024-03-09T20:56:42Z by 0xf66c906920e09126907def2b7daeeb9688ddd694, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xb495573cd2246e7cc7d6d2b37d779463295e5ab0; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
